summary.text: Helena Foulkes is the Democratic nominee for governor. A former CVS Pharmacy executive and former CEO of Hudson's Bay Company, she lost the 2022 Democratic primary to Dan McKee and defeated him in the 2026 primary. Her housing plan would dedicate millionaire's-tax revenue to a revolving loan fund that she says would create 20,000 new homes.

paragraphs.text: Born in Providence; earned a B.A. from Harvard College (1986) and an MBA from Harvard Business School.
Joined CVS in 1992 and rose to executive vice president and chief marketing officer; later chief executive officer of Hudson's Bay Company.
Ran for the 2022 Democratic nomination for governor, losing to Dan McKee.

sources.title: Helena Foulkes calls for millionaire's tax to spur housing growth
